reviewer: Codex visual inspection of rendered evidence

items.finding: Crown and jaw use independent sections, cheeks curve into sides; five traced head widths differ by less than 5%.
Embedded pinna has a medial indentation, rounded lobe and variable thickness; painted rim/concha/short fold remain readable. Internal detail remains a texture approximation.
Brow tips taper without the former central cusp; nose has a wider lower base and blunt rounded triangle profile. Eyes and expression remain painted.
Anterior belly and posterior seat are fuller; torso side contour no longer reads as a thin straight slab. Front widths remain within the baseline tolerances.
Clay pelvis and shoulder transitions are continuous; no black texture spill onto hands or legs observed in the rendered views.

The early sitting spikes were eliminated by preserving weighted joint loops. Reviewed elbow/knee, shoulder, grip and sitting renders; no runaway vertices observed. Soft FK compression at the inner knee and hip remains.
Imported GLB renders retain the silhouette, materials and rig; macOS character-smoke passed for the same GLB hash.

limitations: Side-camera yaw 7.8 degrees and depth are estimates; reference views are not a calibrated orthographic set.
Painted ear/face details remain static approximations, with no geometric internal ear grooves or facial rig.
The simple FK rig retains compression creases at tightly bent knees/hips; no corrective shapes were introduced.
Additional head/ear/side calibration was recorded after initial construction preview; the chronology is stated in reference-calibration-1.4.json.
